samples.xml_description:
<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects the sequence '10011' in the input signal IN.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to the FSM.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="STATE_IDLE" value="2'b00">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STATE_S1" value="2'b01">State after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STATE_S2" value="2'b10">State after detecting '00'.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STATE_MATCH" value="2'b11">Match detected state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state_reg" width="2">Current state of the FSM.</register>
        <wire id="next_state" width="2">Next state of the FSM.</wire>
        <wire id="match_out" width="1">Intermediate match output.</wire>
        <always @(*)>
            // Next state logic
            case (state_reg)
                STATE_IDLE: next_state = IN ? STATE_S1 : STATE_IDLE;
                STATE_S1: next_state = IN == 1'b0 ? STATE_S2 : STATE_IDLE;
                STATE_S2: next_state = IN == 1'b0 ? STATE_S2 : STATE_IDLE;
                STATE_MATCH: next_state = IN ? STATE_S1 : STATE_IDLE;
                default: next_state = STATE_IDLE;
            endcase

            // Match output logic
            match_out = (state_reg == STATE_MATCH);
        endalways

        // Register update logic
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (!RST) begin
                state_reg <= STATE_IDLE;
                MATCH <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                state_reg <= next_state;
                MATCH <= match_out;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        The FSM starts in IDLE state. On each positive edge of CLK or when RST is active, the state transitions according to the input IN.
        - From IDLE, if IN is 1, transition to S1.
        - From S1, if IN is 0, transition to S2.
        - From S2, if IN is 0, stay in S2.
        - From S2, if IN is 1, transition back to IDLE.
        - From S1, if IN is 1, transition to MATCH.
        - From MATCH, if IN is 1, transition back to S1.
        The MATCH output is 1 when the FSM is in the MATCH state.
    </implementation>
</module>
